This card declares blocks: [TASK-354] and sits in tasks/done/, so all three early returns in internal/usecase/task/validator_receipt.go are cleared and ce task validate actually compares this value on every run. The digest excludes quality-review, quality-reviewed-at, quality-review-receipt and review_status, which is why setting the pointer below after taking the digest does not move it.
reviewer: review-371 (Claude Opus 5, independent — did not participate in the 2026-09-10 implementation)
verdict-condition: The card's verification-evidence claimed an independent review that has no supporting artifact. The condition is discharged in the same commit that carries this receipt: the clause is retracted and replaced with a statement that today's review is the first.
head-reviewed: the revision introduced by the commit that carries this receipt. A commit sha cannot be written here without being circular; the canonical digest above identifies the reviewed card content exactly, which is what the validator compares.

findings.summary: verification-evidence claimed an independent review with zero corroboration.
findings.detail: The clause 'independent review confirmed shared truncation contract' has no backing artifact. tasks/done/evidence/TASK-371/ did not exist. The card was filed in 36594bb2 (2026-09-10 12:33:49) and closed in 5fc87d79 (2026-09-10 12:49:49) — sixteen minutes apart, same author, and the sentence was introduced inside the implementer's own closing commit. AGENTS.md acquired the independent-review requirement at 17:50 the same day, after both commits.
findings.resolution: The clause is retracted in the card's verification-evidence and the retraction is restated in the body. Leaving it intact would have made this receipt appear to corroborate a review that never happened — and once the card is sealed by this receipt, that sentence would no longer be correctable (ISSUE-010).

findings.summary: Three unticked Completion Criteria on a status: done card.
findings.detail: All three were satisfied at review time. Criterion 2's exit 1 is owed solely to this card's own receipt gap, not to a progress disagreement.
findings.resolution: Ticked, with criterion 2 annotated to say why its binding exits 1 and that this commit closes it.

findings.summary: The truncation contract is genuine and regression-tested.
findings.detail: tools/planprogress/check.go:304-309 — truncatedPercent guards total == 0 and then returns completed * 100 / total. check_test.go's TestTruncatedPercent pins 15/16=93, 16/26=61, 7/19=36 and 2/3=66; all four diverge from the rounded value, so the table discriminates truncation from rounding rather than merely exercising it. 0/0=0 covers the zero-children case. No other code in the repository rounds a percentage.

findings.summary: ISSUE-002's Resolution Criterion 3 named a document that does not record the claim.
findings.detail: The human binding asserted that TASK-354 §Summary records TASK-371 resolving the progress prerequisite. PLAN-009 §Parallel lane does record it; TASK-354 §Summary records only the receipt blocker.
findings.resolution: The binding and the Recommended Resolution prose in tasks/done/002-*.md now name PLAN-009 only, and state explicitly what TASK-354 does and does not record.

backdating-statement: This review was performed on 2026-09-14. No part of it is backdated to 2026-09-10. The card's original 2026-09-10 verification stands as the implementer's own self-verification and is labelled as such.
lead-verification: The card's author re-measured every load-bearing claim in this receipt independently before accepting it: the commit topology via git log --follow, the absence of tasks/done/evidence/TASK-371, the truncatedPercent source, and the TestTruncatedPercent table. The reviewer verified truncation by injecting 6/7 ad hoc; the tracked table was substituted as the durable evidence because an injected case disappears when the run ends.
